title: Ensure 'Allow Cortana Above Lock' is set to 'Block'

benchmark.product: CIS Microsoft Intune for Windows 11 Benchmark

description:
This policy setting determines whether or not the user can interact with Cortana using speech while the system is locked.

The recommended state for this setting is: Block.
rationale: Access to any computer resource should not be allowed when the device is locked.
impact: The system will need to be unlocked for the user to interact with Cortana using speech.

methods.description:
1. Navigate to the following registry location and note the WinningProvider GUID. This value confirms under which User GUID the policy is set.
2. Navigate to the following registry location and confirm the value is set to 0.

steps.output_description: This value confirms under which User GUID the policy is set.
confirm the value is set to 0
steps.check_command_notes: No original_command exists for either step in this method - CIS only describes the registry paths to navigate to, not a script. This step substitutes the WinningProvider GUID captured in step 1 in place of the source's literal '{GUID}' placeholder; check_command_verified is false because it's unconfirmed whether the captured value includes the enclosing braces the source's placeholder implies, which affects whether the substituted path resolves correctly.

methods.description: To establish the recommended configuration via configuration profiles, set the following Settings Catalog path to 'Block'.

default_value: Enabled. (The user can interact with Cortana using speech while the system is locked.)
